name: Imperial Solar
old_description: At Imperial Solar, we strive to be the best. Our team is highly educated in the field of alternative energy and we possess the most advanced accreditation. We are proud to have achieved the highest awards in customer service as well as having been recognized as one of the top solar contractors in California
about:
Imperial Solar operates from Canoga Park, California, providing solar contractor services across the state. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in its public materials.

The firm specializes in the design and installation of alternative energy systems, primarily solar photovoltaic arrays for residential and commercial clients. Its service portfolio includes free on-site energy evaluations, system sizing, permitting, and installation. No manufacturing facility, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Imperial Solar serves property owners in California seeking renewable energy solutions, including homeowners, businesses, and potentially municipal projects. The company references a focus on "smart and affordable energy choice," indicating a customer base motivated by cost savings and sustainability.

The company differentiates itself through an Angie's List Best Service Award and claims to hold an unspecified advanced accreditation in the alternative energy field. It emphasizes a highly educated team and a track record of customer service recognition as the basis for its market position.
